name: Class File Viewer
description: Read compiled .class files in Orca's editor tabs: declarations in Java syntax, bytecode listed like javap, the file's structure and a linked constant pool. Jars, wars, ears, aars and jmods open as a tree of packages and classes. Offline, no JDK needed. Independent; not affiliated with Oracle.

cover.alt: Read any class in a jar as Java declarations: Telescope’s Outline, compiled for Java 21, beside a tree of 12 classes in 3 packages.

screenshots.alt: See what the compiler wrote, listed like javap -c -v: Catalog’s constructor, stack=3, locals=1, with links to pool entries #1, #7, #9.
Find what uses each constant: #10 Fieldref Catalog.bodies, used 5 times, by <init>, add, map, nearest and iterator; 157 entries.
See each class’s Java version and its multi-release copies: Units, compiled for Java 8, with a switch to its Java 11+ version.
A jar at a glance: Java 21 for 6 classes, 17 for 5, 8 for 1, module demo.observatory and main class demo.observatory.Main.
